author: GamingBolt
description:
From Skies Unknown to the tale of a living legend – or so it seems – Ace Combat is finally back with a brand new title. Launching on October 2nd for Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC, Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve marks several changes and new additions to the franchise. 

Strangereal is still the stage of war, and while you're once again dogfighting enemy aircraft, taking on larger-than-life threats, and trying to make a difference, the presentation, content, and online modes have leveled up.

Let's dive into everything you should know about Ace Combat 8.
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt is already one of the most revered RPGs ever made, but CD Projekt Red isn’t content with letting their classic rest in lieu of its long-awaited sequel. 

The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt: Remastered brings an extensive list of changes, from revamped combat and progression to improved traversal, accessibility, and visual overhauls. And the best thing? Remastered is free if you already own the base game. 

So, whether you’re returning for your tenth playthrough or experiencing Geralt’s adventure for the first time, here’s fifteen of the biggest changes coming to Wild Hunt Remastered.
title: The Witcher 3 Remastered vs. Original - 15 BIGGEST Changes
